text:
GruntWorx should inherit Instead’s reliability rules and shared contracts, with its own API limits and mappings. The existing code suggests five concrete lessons:

1. **Budget requests at both connection and application level.** Instead throttles by API group and connection, plus an app-wide ceiling. Its configured defaults are 5 docs requests/minute per connection and 500/minute app-wide; production raises these to 60 and 3,000. Workers are designed around at most one vendor exchange per job, and HTTP 429 retries honor `Retry-After`. GruntWorx should define its own quota dimensions and throttle keys, while reusing the neutral worker base.  
   Sources: [throttling configuration](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/config/initializers/sidekiq.rb), [production limits](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/config/settings/production.yml), [shared worker](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/workers/tax_preparation/tax_automations/operation_worker.rb:3).

2. **Treat webhooks as the fast path; provide reconciliation for missed deliveries.** Instead selects uploaded documents still `sent` after one hour or `processing` after twelve hours. It groups them by entity/year, paginates folder listings, then checks unseen documents individually—so absence from one folder does not imply deletion. An individual-file 404 maps to `archived`. Both webhook and reconciliation updates use the same status mapper, which ignores duplicates and refuses backward transitions.  
   Carry over this structure, but choose GruntWorx-specific timing. Instead stops considering uploads older than two days; that cutoff needs an explicit operational decision because older stale records remain unchanged.  
   Sources: [candidate selection](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/queries/tax_preparation/tax_automations/documents/reconcile_candidates_query.rb:8), [pagination and fallback](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/workers/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/documents/reconcile_statuses_worker.rb:46), [individual lookup](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/documents/reconcile_status.rb:39).

3. **Keep failure reasons vendor-neutral.** The shared vocabulary is `unexpected`, `no_active_connection`, `network_error`, `unauthorized`, `api_error`, `exceeded`, `forbidden`, and `encrypted`. Instead maps `password_required` to `encrypted`; an unrecognized processing refusal becomes `error` without an invented reason. GruntWorx should translate its responses at the adapter boundary and preserve the distinction between upload failure and processing failure. Also account for recovery: Instead handles `error → completed` by walking through `processing` transactionally.  
   Sources: [shared document model](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/models/tax_preparation/tax_automations/document.rb:11), [Instead status mapper](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/documents/apply_processing_status.rb:10).

4. **Record realistic signed-upload exchanges, sanitize credentials, and replay at recorded time.** Instead’s client specs use live-recorded cassettes for reproducible API responses and HTTP stubs for malformed responses. The global recording hook scrubs signed-upload policies, credentials, and signatures while retaining response shape. `:vcr_fixed_time` freezes replay at the cassette’s original timestamp so recorded expiry dates remain meaningful. One extension is necessary: bearer/token scrubbing currently recognizes Instead’s host specifically; GruntWorx needs equivalent coverage, plus sanitization for any credentials embedded in URL query parameters.  
   Sources: [client specs](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/spec/unit/tax_preparation/lib/tax_automations/instead/client_spec.rb:5), [recording hook](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/spec/spec_helper.rb), [clock helper](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/spec/support/vcr_fixed_time.rb:3).

5. **Prefer existing links; make automatic name matching conservative.** Instead reuses an active linked entity by firm, client, contact, and entity type across tax years. Name matching considers only active, unlinked entities of the correct firm/type and links only a single match. It normalizes punctuation, whitespace, case, and selected business-name spellings; person-name reversal is a fallback only after no direct match. An account name represents a person only when that account has one contact. Ambiguous matches remain unlinked and produce distinct metrics. Preserve these safeguards; define GruntWorx’s identity and entity-type rules separately.  
   Sources: [linked lookup](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/clients/find_entity.rb:32), [matching rules](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/clients/link_entity_by_name.rb:49).

These findings describe the current Instead implementation; they do not establish GruntWorx’s API capabilities or limits. No files were changed.
